css-gradient-generator.name: CSS Linear Gradient Generator
css-gradient-generator.description: Design a linear CSS gradient with color stops, angle and opacity, preview it locally and copy or download the CSS.

meta.title: CSS Linear Gradient Generator
meta.description: Design a linear CSS gradient with color stops, angle and opacity, preview it locally and copy or download the CSS.
meta.keywords: CSS Linear Gradient Generator, CSS, linear-gradient, #RRGGBB, rgba

cssGradient.previewHint: The checkerboard shows transparency and is not part of the exported CSS.
cssGradient.emptyResult: Enter valid gradient settings to see the preview and CSS.
cssGradient.hint: Updates instantly. Use 2–8 color stops in nondecreasing position order. All numbers must be integers.
cssGradient.rules: Angles: −360–360°, with 0° pointing up and 90° pointing right. Colors: #RRGGBB. Positions and opacity: 0–100%. Equal positions create hard transitions. Only linear gradients are generated; no CSS import.
cssGradient.invalidAngle: Enter a whole-number angle from −360 to 360.
cssGradient.invalidColor: Stop {number}: enter a six-digit hex color such as #2563eb.
cssGradient.invalidPosition: Stop {number}: enter a whole-number position from 0 to 100.
cssGradient.invalidOpacity: Stop {number}: enter a whole-number opacity from 0 to 100.
cssGradient.stopOrder: Stop {number}: position must be at least the previous stop’s position.
